assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Food Protection
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Food and utensils shall be protected from contamination. Food contact surfaces used to prepare, store and serve food must be smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable, for example stainless steel or rigid food-grade plastic. Clean utensils will be used to serve food.
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Will use covers, food wrap, single use disposable utensils, individual sampling containers etc. Will use sneeze guards Will use food grade storage containers Cutting boards, cooking utensils, tongs, bowls, table top etc., all cleanable and non-absorbent Other N/A
